label: curated policy target category
definition: A research-curated policy target category used to normalize or compare source expressions across policy documents. It is not thereby asserted to be identical to a category explicitly defined or constituted by a source.

label: target category alignment assertion
definition: An analytical assertion relating a source target-category statement or source-specified category to a curated target category. The alignment records a curation judgement and is deliberately weaker than owl:equivalentClass or rdfs:subClassOf.

label: document actor role
definition: A relational role borne by an institutional actor because it stands in an issuance or publication relation to a policy document.

label: document coverage period assertion
definition: A temporal qualification stating the period covered by a reporting document when the source explicitly presents the interval as a reporting or coverage period.

label: document issuer role
definition: The anti-rigid role of an institutional actor that issues a policy document.

label: document planning period assertion
definition: A temporal qualification stating the planning horizon explicitly associated with a plan, strategy, roadmap, or comparable policy document. It is not the document's physical existence interval and does not automatically establish legal validity.

label: document publisher role
definition: The anti-rigid role of an institutional actor that publishes a policy document.

label: document reference period assertion
definition: A conservative temporal qualification associating a policy document with a reference or edition period when the evidence does not warrant interpreting that period as validity, planning horizon, or reporting coverage.

label: evidence record
definition: An abstract provenance record identifying the documentary source and location used to support a policy-content assertion in the knowledge graph. The evidence record is not the source document itself.

label: explicit target category definition
definition: A source statement that explicitly states extension criteria for a single target category using definitional content such as “means”, “is”, or an equivalent criterion.

label: government organization
definition: An organization belonging to a governmental or public-administration structure. This is a rigid organizational subkind, not a temporary policy role.

label: government post
definition: A socially instituted government office or position that persists independently of the particular office holder, such as a ministerial or commissioner post.

label: institutional actor
definition: An identity-bearing institutional entity that can be referred to in policy or document relations. In CDSG this category presently covers organizations and institutionally constituted government posts; it is not itself a policy role.

label: institutional actor role
definition: An anti-rigid relational role borne by an institutional actor because it stands in a context-defining relation to a policy specification or document.

label: jurisdiction
definition: An identity-bearing legally or institutionally constituted domain of authority used to qualify the applicability, observation, or target context of policy information. Federal, national, subnational, and supranational levels are treated as controlled classifications rather than distinct ontological kinds.

label: normative content
definition: Policy content that has normative force in virtue of an institutional source and context.

label: normative document
definition: A policy document whose institutional status gives normative force to at least some content it expresses, such as a statute, regulation, executive order, or formal administrative decision.

label: normative effective period assertion
definition: A source-relative temporal qualification stating an effective or applicability interval for a normative document. It is distinct from the document's issue date and should be used only when the source warrants an effectiveness interpretation.

label: normative target category definition
definition: An explicit target-category definition that is also normative content with institutional force in a jurisdiction.

label: normatively constituted policy target category
definition: A source-specified policy target category whose membership or status is constituted by a normative rule rather than merely described by a lexical definition.

label: normatively defined policy target category
definition: A source-defined policy target category whose explicit definition is normative content carrying institutional force in a jurisdiction.

label: operationalized policy target category
definition: A source-specified policy target category whose membership criteria are operationalized for statistical or administrative use rather than presented as a legal definition.

label: organization
definition: A socially constituted functional complex with an organizational identity that persists through changes in members, office holders, and many internal arrangements.

label: policy assertion
definition: Policy content that asserts or reports that some policy-relevant state of affairs, event, status, or outcome obtains or obtained. An assertion is distinct from the situation or event it describes.

label: policy content
definition: An abstract information content item expressed in one or more policy documents. It can be a prescription, goal, definition, recommendation, or descriptive assertion, but is not itself the document that bears it.

label: policy document
definition: A socially recognized information-bearing document used to formulate, mandate, explain, evaluate, or report public policy. The document is distinct from the abstract policy content that it expresses.

label: policy target category
definition: A higher-order type used to classify endurants as belonging to a policy-relevant category. A policy target category is distinct from a definition or rule that specifies its criteria, from any concrete bearer falling under it, and from the anti-rigid policy-target role a bearer may acquire in a policy context.

label: policy target category statement
definition: Source-expressed policy content concerning the criteria, constitution, operationalization, classification, or terminology of policy target categories. Subclasses distinguish these different semantic functions.

label: policy target role
definition: An anti-rigid relational role borne by a concrete endurant because policy content places it among the targets of a policy, directly or through a target category it falls under. It is distinct from the target category itself, and membership in a category does not by itself entail the role.

label: source-defined policy target category
definition: A source-specified policy target category whose extension is stated through an explicit category definition.

label: source-specified policy target category
definition: A policy target category whose extension criteria or membership conditions are explicitly specified by a represented source statement. It is distinct from a research-curated comparison category.

label: statistical target category definition
definition: An explicit target-category definition used by a statistical authority or standard and not represented as a normatively constitutive legal definition.

label: statistically defined policy target category
definition: A source-defined policy target category whose extension criteria are stated in a statistical standard or statistical definition rather than constituted by a normative rule.

label: target category classification-scheme statement
definition: A source statement specifying a classification scheme, classification dimensions, or a set of categories without defining a single policy target category represented as one OWL class.

label: target category constitution rule
definition: Normative content that establishes how membership in or acquisition of a policy-relevant legal status or category comes about. It is not conflated with a lexical category definition.

label: target category operationalization
definition: A source statement giving operational criteria used to delimit membership in a single policy-relevant target category without treating those criteria as a legal definition.

label: target category terminology statement
definition: A source statement about the terminology used for one or more population or target categories, without itself fixing the extension of a single target category.

label: target population operationalization statement
definition: A source statement identifying indicators, dimensions, or measurement variables for operationalizing a target-population construct without fixing the extension of one single policy target category.

label: temporal qualification assertion
definition: A source-relative assertion that qualifies a policy-relevant item with a temporal interval. It reifies the qualification so that the semantic kind of time relation, the interval, the qualified item, and provenance can be represented separately.

normative document version
definition: A published text state of a normative document: the original text as made or published, or an official consolidation that incorporates amendments up to a stated point. Each version is a version of exactly one normative document, and a source statement is cited from a version.

label: document supersession assertion
definition: A source-relative assertion that a later document replaces an earlier one, so that the definitions or classifications the later document expresses take the place of those in the earlier document. It is recorded only where a source states the replacement.
